versions.changelog:
Initial release: Automatically transforms PRD documents into fully functional SwiftUI iOS projects.

- Generates production-ready Xcode projects using MVVM architecture with modular structure.
- Seamless PRD integration; analyzes requirements and builds models, view models, and SwiftUI views.
- Auto-triggers quality assurance by invoking qa-skill after code generation.
- Ensures all code meets SwiftUI/iOS best practices, Xcode 15+ compatibility, and Apple's interface guidelines.
- Supports adaptive UI, accessibility, reminders, sharing, notifications, and iCloud sync features based on PRD input.
